Faith healer hospitalized after snakebite incident

A faith healer in Chhatarpur, who reportedly treated patients using slips of paper, was hospitalized after a snake appeared under his foot, causing him to faint in fear. He was then bitten by the snake, and his condition became serious. The incident occurred when the healer, known for expelling illnesses and spirits from others, encountered the venomous snake.
